title: The authz-agent schema.
description: JSON Schema for the authz-agent chart values.

ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION.description: Artifact descriptor version which is installed
ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION.title: The ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION schema

IMAGE_REPOSITORY.description: Image repository of the service without the tag; the image is IMAGE_REPOSITORY:TAG
IMAGE_REPOSITORY.title: The IMAGE_REPOSITORY schema

DEPLOYMENT_VERSION.description: Deployment version. Provided if facade/bluegreen mode is true
DEPLOYMENT_VERSION.title: The DEPLOYMENT_VERSION schema

DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE.description: Specify Deployment Strategy type for deploying service
DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE.title: The DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE schema

CLOUD_TOPOLOGIES.description: Array of topologies settings for topologySpreadConstraints. Each array item must contain at least 'topologyKey' attribute. Other supported attributes are 'maxSkew' and 'whenUnsatisfiable' - optional
CLOUD_TOPOLOGIES.title: The CLOUD_TOPOLOGIES schema

MONITORING_ENABLED.description: Set to true to import dashboards to Grafana and configure integration with Prometheus. Requires Platform System Monitor CRDs to be deployed to target k8s/openshift cluster
MONITORING_ENABLED.title: The MONITORING_ENABLED schema

READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.description: Read-only container file system is enabled
READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.title: The READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED schema

MANAGED_BY.title: The MANAGED_BY schema
MANAGED_BY.description: The tool being used to manage the operation of an application

DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.title: The DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID schema
DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.description: Unique identifier of deployment session used to track e2e deploy activity

KUBERNETES_M2M_ENABLED.title: The KUBERNETES_M2M_ENABLED schema
KUBERNETES_M2M_ENABLED.description: Parameter specifies if M2M authentication with Kubernetes service account tokens is enabled

MESH_ROUTES_ENABLED.title: The MESH_ROUTES_ENABLED schema
MESH_ROUTES_ENABLED.description: Registers the check API on the platform gateways through Mesh custom resources handled by core-operator. Set to false on a cluster without core-operator, or when access-control keeps serving these routes in the same namespace

IMAGE_PULL_POLICY.title: The IMAGE_PULL_POLICY schema
IMAGE_PULL_POLICY.description: Image pull policy of every container. IfNotPresent suits immutable pipeline tags; set Always where a moving tag must win on every restart

LOG_LEVEL.title: The LOG_LEVEL schema
LOG_LEVEL.description: Root log level of the service, passed to the container as LOGGING_LEVEL_ROOT

AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_FILE.title: The AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_FILE schema
AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_FILE.description: Path where the trusted-providers ConfigMap is mounted; the agent watches this file

IDENTITY_PROVIDER_URL.title: The IDENTITY_PROVIDER_URL schema
IDENTITY_PROVIDER_URL.description: Base URL of the platform identity provider, without a realm. Used to generate the trusted providers when AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS is empty

AUTHZ_IDP_REALMS.title: The AUTHZ_IDP_REALMS schema
AUTHZ_IDP_REALMS.description: Realms to trust when the provider list is generated from IDENTITY_PROVIDER_URL. Each name becomes a provider id; cloud-common is marked required. An empty list means no providers

AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS.title: The AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS schema
AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS.description: Explicit trusted token providers, rendered into the trusted-providers ConfigMap. An entry names either an issuer, resolved through OIDC discovery, or a jwksUri, never both. Empty means the list is generated from IDENTITY_PROVIDER_URL and AUTHZ_IDP_REALMS

AUTHZ_TENANT_MANAGER_URL.title: The AUTHZ_TENANT_MANAGER_URL schema
AUTHZ_TENANT_MANAGER_URL.description: Address of tenant-manager, used to resolve a realm named by its tenant display name once discovery for that name has failed. Empty disables the lookup

AUTHZ_JWKS_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED.title: The AUTHZ_JWKS_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED schema
AUTHZ_JWKS_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED.description: true: every explicitly configured provider must be fetched before the Pod is Ready; false: one is enough. A generated provider list always behaves as false, and providers marked required must bootstrap either way

AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_TIMEOUT.title: The AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_TIMEOUT schema
AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_TIMEOUT.description: Per-request timeout in seconds for OIDC discovery and JWKS fetches

AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_RETRIES.title: The AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_RETRIES schema
AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_RETRIES.description: Retry count for OIDC discovery and JWKS fetches

AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_RELOAD_INTERVAL.title: The AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_RELOAD_INTERVAL schema
AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_RELOAD_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between checks of the mounted trusted-providers file. 0 turns the watcher off, so provider changes need a Pod restart

AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_SOURCE_URL.title: The AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_SOURCE_URL schema
AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_SOURCE_URL.description: Base URL of the policy source the pull loop reads from: the platform's access-control, or the authz-policy-admin stub from helm-templates/authz-policy-admin. Empty disables the pull

AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_PULL_INTERVAL.title: The AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_PULL_INTERVAL schema
AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_PULL_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between policy pulls. 0 disables the pull

AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_TOKEN_FILE.title: The AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_TOKEN_FILE schema
AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_TOKEN_FILE.description: Path of the Bearer token the pull loop sends, written by the kubelet when KUBERNETES_M2M_ENABLED is true and by the agent's own token loop otherwise

AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_URL.title: The AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_URL schema
AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_URL.description: Base URL of the entitlements service a condition on subject.entitledResources calls. Empty makes such a condition fail, and the item is denied

AUTHZ_DECISION_LOG_PATH.title: The AUTHZ_DECISION_LOG_PATH schema
AUTHZ_DECISION_LOG_PATH.description: Directory where the decision-log collector writes its NDJSON file, on ephemeral container storage

HPA_ENABLED.description: Defines whether horizontal autoscaling enabled for microservice
HPA_ENABLED.title: The HPA_ENABLED schema

HPA_MIN_REPLICAS.description: Defines the lower limit for the number of replicas to which the autoscaler can scale down
HPA_MIN_REPLICAS.title: The HPA_MIN_REPLICAS schema

HPA_MAX_REPLICAS.description: Defines the upper limit for the number of replicas to which the autoscaler can scale up. It cannot be less that HPA_MIN_REPLICAS
HPA_MAX_REPLICAS.title: The HPA_MAX_REPLICAS schema

HPA_AVG_CPU_UTILIZATION_TARGET_PERCENT.description: Target average CPU utilization for horizontal pod autoscaling
HPA_AVG_CPU_UTILIZATION_TARGET_PERCENT.title: The HPA_AVG_CPU_UTILIZATION_TARGET_PERCENT schema

HPA_SCALING_UP_SELECT_POLICY.description: Defines behavior.scaleUp.selectPolicy property in HPA resource. Allowed values are: Min, Max, Disabled
HPA_SCALING_UP_SELECT_POLICY.title: The HPA_SCALING_UP_SELECT_POLICY schema

HPA_SCALING_UP_PODS_VALUE.description: Defines behavior.scaleUp.policies[].value property in HPA resource for Pods type
HPA_SCALING_UP_PODS_VALUE.title: The HPA_SCALING_UP_PODS_VALUE schema

HPA_SCALING_UP_PODS_PERIOD_SECONDS.description: Defines behavior.scaleUp.policies[].periodSeconds property in HPA resource for Pods type
HPA_SCALING_UP_PODS_PERIOD_SECONDS.title: The HPA_SCALING_UP_PODS_PERIOD_SECONDS schema

HPA_SCALING_UP_PERCENT_VALUE.description: Defines behavior.scaleUp.policies[].value property in HPA resource for Percent type
HPA_SCALING_UP_PERCENT_VALUE.title: The HPA_SCALING_UP_PERCENT_VALUE schema

HPA_SCALING_UP_PERCENT_PERIOD_SECONDS.description: Defines behavior.scaleUp.policies[].periodSeconds property in HPA resource for Percent type
HPA_SCALING_UP_PERCENT_PERIOD_SECONDS.title: The HPA_SCALING_UP_PERCENT_PERIOD_SECONDS schema

HPA_SCALING_DOWN_SELECT_POLICY.description: Defines behavior.scaleDown.selectPolicy property in HPA resource. Allowed values are: Min, Max, Disabled
HPA_SCALING_DOWN_SELECT_POLICY.title: The HPA_SCALING_DOWN_SELECT_POLICY schema

HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PODS_VALUE.description: Defines behavior.scaleDown.policies[].value property in HPA resource for Pods type
HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PODS_VALUE.title: The HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PODS_VALUE schema

HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PODS_PERIOD_SECONDS.description: Defines behavior.scaleDown.policies[].periodSeconds property in HPA resource for Pods type
HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PODS_PERIOD_SECONDS.title: The HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PODS_PERIOD_SECONDS schema

HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PERCENT_VALUE.description: Defines behavior.scaleDown.policies[].value property in HPA resource for Percent type
HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PERCENT_VALUE.title: The HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PERCENT_VALUE schema

HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PERCENT_PERIOD_SECONDS.description: Defines behavior.scaleDown.policies[].periodSeconds property in HPA resource for Percent type
HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PERCENT_PERIOD_SECONDS.title: The HPA_SCALING_DOWN_PERCENT_PERIOD_SECONDS schema

CPU_REQUEST.title: The CPU_REQUEST schema
CPU_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of CPU the container will use to start

CPU_LIMIT.title: The CPU_LIMIT schema
CPU_LIMIT.description: Defines maximum amount of CPU the container can use

MEMORY_REQUEST.title: The MEMORY_REQUEST schema
MEMORY_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of memory the container will use to start

MEMORY_LIMIT.title: The MEMORY_LIMIT schema
MEMORY_LIMIT.description: Defines maximum amount of memory the container can use

AUTHZ_AGENT_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_REQUEST.title: The AUTHZ_AGENT_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_REQUEST schema
AUTHZ_AGENT_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of ephemeral storage the agent container will use to start

AUTHZ_AGENT_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_LIMIT.title: The AUTHZ_AGENT_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_LIMIT schema
AUTHZ_AGENT_EPHEMERAL_STORAGE_LIMIT.description: Defines maximum amount of ephemeral storage the agent container is allowed to use

AUTHZ_DECISION_LOG_SIZE_LIMIT.title: The AUTHZ_DECISION_LOG_SIZE_LIMIT schema
AUTHZ_DECISION_LOG_SIZE_LIMIT.description: Defines maximum size of the emptyDir volume the decision log is written to
